verdict.rationale: Kong ships official CLIs — decK for declarative API Lifecycle Automation and kongctl for managing Konnect/Gateway including AI Gateway v2 migrations — both documented with dedicated docs pages, satisfying the 'official CLI' story for an AI-native user managing AI/MCP-related gateway config. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community corroboration of CLI usability, and no explicit evidence of CLI-native agentic workflows (e.g., CLI designed for AI agents to invoke rather than humans).
